description: Lock a channel by denying everyone the ability to send messages and start threads. Roles and members with their own permission to post on the channel keep it, so moderators set up that way keep access; the result names them. Reverse with unlock_channel, which puts back exactly what the lock changed.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.
